indicators.label: Real GDP growth
indicators.source: MoSPI National Accounts, base 2022-23 (constant prices)

indicators.label: CPI inflation
indicators.source: MoSPI CPI, base 2024, All India combined
indicators.note: From January 2026: MoSPI's CPI on the 2024 base. Earlier months: CPI inflation as published on the 2012 base (RBI DBIE). The two series agree within about 0.1 point where they overlap.

indicators.label: Core CPI inflation (excluding food and fuel)
indicators.source: Computed from MoSPI CPI component indices and official weights
indicators.note: CPI excluding food and beverages and household fuel (electricity, gas and other fuels), All India combined. Computed from MoSPI's published indices with MoSPI's basket weights (2024 base: food 36.75%, fuel 5.49%; 2012 base: food 45.86%, fuel and light 6.84%). Petrol and diesel for vehicles stay in, as in the usual Indian measure. Not an official MoSPI series.

indicators.label: Nominal GDP growth
indicators.source: MoSPI National Accounts, base 2022-23 (current prices)
indicators.note: GDP growth at current prices, before adjusting for inflation.

indicators.label: GDP deflator inflation
indicators.source: Derived from MoSPI National Accounts (current and constant prices)
indicators.note: Implied GDP deflator inflation: (1 + nominal growth) / (1 + real growth) - 1. The broadest measure of inflation across everything the economy produces.

indicators.label: CPI inflation, rural
indicators.source: MoSPI CPI, rural, base 2024 (2012 base before 2026)
indicators.note: All India rural CPI inflation. From January 2026 MoSPI's 2024-base series; earlier months as published on the 2012 base.

indicators.label: CPI inflation, urban
indicators.source: MoSPI CPI, urban, base 2024 (2012 base before 2026)
indicators.note: All India urban CPI inflation. From January 2026 MoSPI's 2024-base series; earlier months as published on the 2012 base.

indicators.label: Households' inflation expectations, one year ahead
indicators.source: RBI, Inflation Expectations Survey of Households (bi-monthly)
indicators.note: Median of what urban households in 19 cities say inflation is now and expect it to be, in the survey round named (about 6,000 responses a round). Households' figures run well above measured CPI inflation; RBI reads them for direction rather than level.

indicators.label: Households' inflation expectations, three months ahead
indicators.source: RBI, Inflation Expectations Survey of Households (bi-monthly)
indicators.note: Median of what urban households in 19 cities say inflation is now and expect it to be, in the survey round named (about 6,000 responses a round). Households' figures run well above measured CPI inflation; RBI reads them for direction rather than level.

indicators.label: Households' perception of current inflation
indicators.source: RBI, Inflation Expectations Survey of Households (bi-monthly)
indicators.note: Median of what urban households in 19 cities say inflation is now and expect it to be, in the survey round named (about 6,000 responses a round). Households' figures run well above measured CPI inflation; RBI reads them for direction rather than level.

indicators.label: IIP growth
indicators.source: MoSPI IIP quick estimate, base 2022-23
indicators.note: New 2022-23 base, back data from April 2023. MoSPI has not published June 2023 to March 2024 on this base.

indicators.label: WPI inflation
indicators.source: MoSPI (Office of the Economic Adviser data), WPI base 2022-23
indicators.note: Year-on-year change in the WPI headline index, 2022-23 base; the series starts in 2023, so inflation is available from 2024.

indicators.label: WPI food inflation
indicators.source: MoSPI (Office of the Economic Adviser data), WPI base 2022-23
indicators.note: Year-on-year change in the WPI food index, 2022-23 base; the series starts in 2023, so inflation is available from 2024.

indicators.label: Capacity utilisation in manufacturing
indicators.source: RBI, Order Books, Inventories and Capacity Utilisation Survey (OBICUS, quarterly)
indicators.note: Share of installed capacity in use, from about 1,000 manufacturing companies. It peaks every January to March, so it is compared with the same quarter a year earlier. Results come out about three months after the quarter ends.

indicators.label: Capacity utilisation in manufacturing, seasonally adjusted
indicators.source: RBI, Order Books, Inventories and Capacity Utilisation Survey (OBICUS, quarterly)
indicators.note: Seasonally adjusted by RBI (X-13 ARIMA-SEATS), so one quarter can be compared with the next. RBI publishes it from Q4 2022-23.

indicators.label: Manufacturing PMI (HSBC)
indicators.source: HSBC India Manufacturing PMI, S&P Global
indicators.note: Above 50 means activity is expanding. Only the latest readings are collected.

indicators.label: Services PMI (HSBC)
indicators.source: HSBC India Services PMI (business activity), S&P Global
indicators.note: Above 50 means activity is expanding. Only the latest readings are collected.

indicators.label: Crude oil price (Indian basket)
indicators.source: PPAC, Crude Oil FOB Price (Indian Basket)
indicators.note: Monthly average FOB price of the crude basket Indian refineries import (Brent Dated as the sweet grade, Oman and Dubai as the sour grade). PPAC does not publish monthly figures for 2022-23 on its site, so that year is a gap.

indicators.label: Crude oil price in rupees
indicators.source: PPAC Indian basket (US$) x RBI reference rate (month end)
indicators.note: Indian basket price in US$ multiplied by the rupee's month-end reference rate: what a barrel costs in rupees. A weaker rupee raises it even when dollar prices are flat.

indicators.label: Unemployment rate
indicators.source: MoSPI Periodic Labour Force Survey, monthly
indicators.note: Current weekly status, persons aged 15 and above, rural and urban combined. Monthly estimates start in April 2025; March 2026 was not published.

indicators.label: Merchandise exports
indicators.source: Ministry of Commerce & Industry

indicators.label: Merchandise imports
indicators.source: Ministry of Commerce & Industry

indicators.label: Merchandise trade balance
indicators.source: Ministry of Commerce & Industry

indicators.label: Current account balance
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (latest release reporting each quarter)

indicators.label: Services exports
indicators.source: RBI, Monthly data on India's international trade in services
indicators.note: Latest two months provisional; earlier months revised with the quarterly balance of payments.

indicators.label: Services imports
indicators.source: RBI, Monthly data on India's international trade in services
indicators.note: Latest two months provisional; earlier months revised with the quarterly balance of payments.

indicators.label: Services trade surplus
indicators.source: RBI, Monthly data on India's international trade in services
indicators.note: Latest two months provisional; earlier months revised with the quarterly balance of payments.

indicators.label: Remittances (personal transfer receipts)
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)
indicators.note: Personal transfer receipts, mainly money sent home by Indians working abroad, as stated in RBI's quarterly release.

indicators.label: Current account balance, US$
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)
indicators.note: Revisions RBI states in later releases are applied, so components may not add up exactly for revised quarters.

indicators.label: Current account: goods balance
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)

indicators.label: Current account: services balance
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)

indicators.label: Current account: primary income (net)
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)

indicators.label: Current account: transfers (net)
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (quarterly)

indicators.label: Forex reserves
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Rupee per US dollar
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: RBI reference rate at month end.

indicators.label: 3-month forward premium on US$
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: External debt, gross
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Net international investment position
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Centre's fiscal deficit
indicators.source: CGA, Union Government Accounts (Rs 7.14 lakh crore)
indicators.note: Cumulative from April, as a share of the full-year budget estimate; resets each April.

indicators.label: Centre's capital expenditure
indicators.source: CGA, Union Government Accounts
indicators.note: Capital expenditure, cumulative from April, as a share of the full-year budget estimate; resets each April.

indicators.label: GST on domestic transactions (gross)
indicators.source: GSTN, monthly GST revenue report (provisional)
indicators.note: GST on domestic transactions, as reported by GSTN for the month (provisional). Compared with the same month a year earlier, as stated in the same report, so both exclude compensation cess.

indicators.label: GST on imports (gross)
indicators.source: GSTN, monthly GST revenue report (provisional)
indicators.note: GST on imports, as reported by GSTN for the month (provisional). Compared with the same month a year earlier, as stated in the same report, so both exclude compensation cess.

indicators.label: Gross GST collections
indicators.source: GSTN, monthly GST revenue report (provisional)
indicators.note: Published gross collections. Up to October 2025 they include compensation cess; from November 2025 they do not, so the change against a year earlier is measured on the excluding-cess series.

indicators.label: Net direct tax collections, this year so far
indicators.source: CBDT, Direct Tax Collections (provisional, from TINMIS)
indicators.note: Collections from 1 April to the date shown, after refunds, as CBDT releases them during the year. Provisional. Here securities transaction tax is shown on its own; in the annual series it is part of non-corporate tax. Values are cumulative within each financial year, so compare only with the same date a year earlier.

indicators.label: Net direct tax collections
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Collections net of refunds: corporate tax, non-corporate tax and other direct taxes. CBDT publishes this series once a year. 2024-25 provisional.

indicators.label: Corporate tax collections
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Tax on company profits, net of refunds. Fell in 2019-20 after the September 2019 cut in the corporate tax rate. 2024-25 provisional.

indicators.label: Non-corporate tax collections (mainly personal income tax)
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Income tax paid by individuals, Hindu undivided families, firms, associations of persons and other non-company taxpayers, plus securities transaction tax. 2024-25 provisional.

indicators.label: Gross direct tax collections (before refunds)
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Before refunds, by mode of payment (TDS, advance tax, self-assessment, regular assessment, other receipts). The gap to net collections roughly equals refunds paid, though the two come from different CBDT systems.

indicators.label: Direct tax to GDP ratio
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Net direct taxes as a share of GDP at current prices, using the GDP estimate CBDT cites from MoSPI for each year.

indicators.label: Direct taxes' share of total tax revenue
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Direct taxes as a share of the Centre's gross direct plus indirect tax collections (indirect taxes from CBIC).

indicators.label: Direct tax buoyancy
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Growth in direct tax collections divided by growth in nominal GDP. Above 1 means taxes grew faster than the economy. CBDT does not compute it for 2020-21, when both fell.

indicators.label: Cost of collecting direct taxes
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: The Income Tax Department's spending as a share of what it collects.

indicators.label: Persons filing income-tax returns
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Persons (by PAN) who filed at least one income-tax return during the financial year.

indicators.label: Income-tax returns filed
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: Returns filed during the financial year, including revised returns. Until 2017-18 a belated return for the previous year could also be filed, so 2018-19 dips.

indicators.label: Taxpayers (return filers plus those with tax deducted at source)
indicators.source: CBDT, Income Tax Department Time Series Data (annual, to 2024-25)
indicators.note: By assessment year: persons who filed a return for the year, or had tax deducted at source in the relevant financial year without filing a return.

indicators.label: State government market borrowing
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Policy repo rate
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Standing deposit facility rate
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Marginal standing facility rate
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Cash reserve ratio
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Real policy rate (repo minus CPI inflation)
indicators.source: Derived: RBI policy repo rate minus MoSPI CPI inflation
indicators.note: The policy repo rate at each month's end minus CPI inflation for that month. Near zero or below means borrowing is cheap once inflation is allowed for, so policy is not restraining demand.

indicators.label: Real 10-year yield (G-sec minus CPI inflation)
indicators.source: Derived: RBI 10-year G-sec yield minus MoSPI CPI inflation
indicators.note: The 10-year G-sec yield at each month's end minus CPI inflation for that month. Near zero or below means borrowing is cheap once inflation is allowed for, so policy is not restraining demand.

indicators.label: 91-day T-bill yield
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: 10-year G-sec yield
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: FBIL benchmark 10-year yield, last reading of the week.

indicators.label: Non-food bank credit growth
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: Growth computed from fortnightly outstanding credit. From Dec 2025 RBI reports month-end figures instead of the last reporting Friday, so growth around that change compares dates up to two weeks apart. The latest month uses RBI's published figure where entered.

indicators.label: Credit to agriculture and allied activities
indicators.compare_period: Growth a year earlier (Sep 2025), as restated by RBI
indicators.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (monthly release)
indicators.note: Growth as first published for each month (select banks covering about 92 to 95% of non-food credit). July 2023 to June 2025 exclude the HDFC merger, as RBI's headline does. From December 2025 RBI compares last-day-of-month figures, so the year-ago rate it now restates can differ slightly from the one first published.

indicators.label: Credit to industry
indicators.compare_period: Growth a year earlier (Sep 2025), as restated by RBI
indicators.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (monthly release)

indicators.label: Credit to services
indicators.compare_period: Growth a year earlier (Sep 2025), as restated by RBI
indicators.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (monthly release)

indicators.label: Personal loans
indicators.compare_period: Growth a year earlier (Sep 2025), as restated by RBI
indicators.source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (monthly release)

indicators.label: Bank deposit growth
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: Growth computed from fortnightly outstanding deposits; see the note on reporting dates under bank credit.

indicators.label: Credit-deposit ratio
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: Bank credit as a share of aggregate deposits, computed from RBI's fortnightly levels.

indicators.label: Broad money (M3) growth
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: Growth computed from fortnightly M3 outstanding.

indicators.label: Net FDI
indicators.source: RBI Bulletin October 2026, Table 35 Foreign Investment Inflows (provisional)

indicators.label: Gross FDI into India
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Net portfolio investment
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
indicators.note: RBI's net portfolio investment, which is wider than FPI equity and debt flows reported by NSDL.

indicators.label: Net NRI deposit inflows
indicators.source: RBI, Developments in India's balance of payments (monthly, from April 2026)
indicators.note: Net inflow into NRI deposit accounts. RBI's 5 June 2026 measures on NRI deposits drew US$ 119 bn in April to August 2026, against US$ 6 bn a year earlier. Monthly figures exist only for April to August of 2025 and 2026.

indicators.label: External commercial borrowing registrations
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators

indicators.label: Digital payments, value
indicators.source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE), Macro-economic Indicators
